ShortDescription.Value: Plan journeys through your city by selecting citizens or buildings, using CS2's native routes and public transport.

Publish.LongDescription:
Journey Planner lets you explore your city from a citizen's point of view.
**Select a citizen** Click a citizen while Journey Planner is open. If the citizen already has a native CS2 journey, Journey Planner reads and displays it automatically.
**Plan from building to building** Click a building to set the start, then click another building for the destination. The journey calculates automatically once both points are selected.
**Native journey information** Journey Planner uses Cities: Skylines II's own path data to show walking and public-transport legs, stops and route information. The route can also be drawn directly in the city.
**Quality-of-life features** - JP button in the top-right toolbar - Automatic citizen journey detection - Automatic A to B calculation - Click Start or Destination to open the normal CS2 info panel - Hide/show rendered route - Delete route without clearing Start and Destination - Recalculate the same journey - Press ESC to close Journey Planner
Journey Planner is intended as a player-facing journey viewer and planner. It does not intentionally alter the simulation or transport logic.
Publish.ChangeLog: Initial public release. - Select citizens directly to inspect their current native journey - Select two buildings to plan an A to B journey automatically - Native walking and public-transport legs - Route visualization in the city - Open normal CS2 info panels from selected Start/Destination rows - Hide, show, delete and recalculate routes - JP toolbar button and ESC-to-close support
